next_meeting.note: Host and date of the next regular summit not announced; whether a 2026 regular (35th) summit was held could not be verified.

title.en: Nabil Fahmy becomes Arab League Secretary-General
title.zh: 納比勒．法赫米出任阿盟秘書長

summary.en: In June 2026 Arab League members unanimously approved former Egyptian foreign minister Nabil Fahmy as Secretary-General, succeeding Ahmed Aboul Gheit.
summary.zh: 2026年6月，阿拉伯聯盟成員一致通過由埃及前外長納比勒．法赫米出任秘書長，接替阿布蓋特。

question.en: How much can a secretary-general shape an organization that decides by consensus?
question.zh: 在採共識決的組織裡，秘書長能發揮多大影響力？

title.en: Iranian strikes hit Qatar gas hub
title.zh: 伊朗飛彈攻擊卡達天然氣樞紐

summary.en: In March 2026 Iranian missiles damaged Qatar's Ras Laffan gas facilities; Qatar ordered Iran's embassy military and security attachés to leave within 24 hours.
summary.zh: 2026年3月，伊朗飛彈攻擊造成卡達拉斯拉凡天然氣設施受損；卡達下令伊朗使館武官與安全官員24小時內離境。

question.en: How do security shocks in the Gulf spread to oil and LNG prices worldwide?
question.zh: 海灣地區的安全衝擊如何傳導到全球石油與液化天然氣價格？

text.zh: 七國在開羅創立阿拉伯聯盟

text.en: Joint Defence and Economic Cooperation Treaty signed
text.zh: 簽署《聯合防禦與經濟合作條約》

text.en: Egypt suspended; HQ moves to Tunis after Camp David
text.zh: 大衛營協議後埃及遭停權，總部遷往突尼斯

text.en: Egypt readmitted; HQ returns to Cairo (1990)
text.zh: 埃及恢復會籍，總部於1990年遷回開羅

text.en: Greater Arab Free Trade Area (GAFTA) agreed
text.zh: 同意成立大阿拉伯自由貿易區（GAFTA）

text.zh: 貝魯特峰會通過《阿拉伯和平倡議》
